info.name: MEXA Program Transfer — Gateway API
info.description:
The machine's gateway (Node-RED PC, laptop, any program) and the MEXA server: **4 HTTPS calls**.

| Call | |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/device/v1/status` | New program? Backup asked for? |
| `GET /api/device/v1/program` | Download the machine's program |
| `POST /api/device/v1/backup` | Upload a backup (multipart `file`) |
| `POST /api/device/v1/report` | Program written / refused, backup could not be read |

**Set the variables** (collection → Variables): `baseUrl` = the server, e.g. `https://stmapi.stmcnc.com`; `token` = the machine's token (`mxd_…`, from Program Transfer → the machine → Gateway token).

How the gateway talks to the CNC (FTP, FOCAS, a folder, anything) is up to the gateway. Full guide: docs/PROGRAM_TRANSFER_API.md.

item.name: Gateway — the 4 calls (give this to the gateway team)

request.description:
Call every `poll_seconds` (15 s).

- `program` is the machine's program (the newest upload). When its `sha256` differs from the program you last wrote to the CNC **and** `status` is `WAITING`, download it (call 2). `DONE` / `FAILED` mean you already reported this file — do not try it again.
- `backup_request` is not null when someone pressed **Backup now**: read the program from the CNC and upload it (call 4a), or report that you could not (call 4b).

The tests below save `fileId`, `sha256` and `backupRequestId` for the next calls.

exec: if (body.program.status === 'WAITING') console.log('New program waiting:', body.program.program_name, '→ call 2. Download the program');
} else console.log('No program uploaded for this machine yet.');
console.log('Backup asked for → read the program from the CNC and call 4a. Upload a backup (or 4b on failure)');

request.description:
The machine refused the program. `message` (required, up to 500 characters) is what the person sees: **The machine could not use it: …**. They upload a corrected file, which comes with a new `file_id` and `sha256`.

Do not try the same `file_id` again: `/status` now shows it as `FAILED`.

Text NC programs up to 20 MB; extensions `.nc .prg .cnc .txt .tap .eia .min .gcode .ptp .mpf .spf` or none (`O1234`).

item.name: 4b. Report — backup could not be read (FAILED)

request.description:
The backup someone asked for could not be read. The request closes, the page shows **Backup failed: …** and **Backup now** works again; the person who asked is warned.

(A backup that worked needs no report: uploading it with 4a answers the request.)

item.description:
Every call sends the machine's token: `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (set on the collection). One token per machine; it says which machine the call is about.

**The gateway loop**

```
every 15 s:  GET /status
  program.status == WAITING and sha256 is new  → GET /program → write to the CNC
                                                 → POST /report {file_id, status: DONE}
                                                   or {file_id, status: FAILED, message}
  backup_request != null                       → read the program from the CNC
                                                 → POST /backup (file)
                                                   or POST /report {backup_request_id, status: FAILED, message}
```

Errors are always JSON: `{"status":"error","code":"…","message":"…"}`. 429 = too many calls: wait and try again.

item.name: Web side — to test the flow without the page (internal, do not share)

request.description: A person's sign-in (company admin), to play the web page's part. Saves `userToken`.
The company's machines, each with its gateway, program (and what the gateway reported), last backup and open backup request. Saves the first machine as `machineId` unless one is set.

item.name: c. Make the machine's gateway token

request.description: Makes (or replaces) the machine's gateway token and saves it as `token` for the gateway folder. Shown once — the old one stops at once.

item.name: d. Upload a program (as the page does)

request.description: What **Upload program** on the page does: the file becomes the machine's program, and `/status` shows it as WAITING.

item.name: e. Backup now (as the page does)

request.description: What **Backup now** on the page does: `/status` then shows a `backup_request`.

item.description:
Plays the person's part, to run the whole flow from Postman: a → b → c (gets the gateway token) → d (upload) → then the gateway calls 1, 2, 3a/3b → e (Backup now) → 1, 4a/4b.

Uses a person's login: remove this folder before sending the collection to the gateway team.
